ai.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of OpenAI Codex. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-110930.
ai.title: ZDI-26-968: (Pwn2Own) OpenAI Codex GUI OpenProjectInCodex Argument Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

ai.summary: OpenAI is bringing AI agents into more of the software security process with Daybreak, pairing web application penetration testing with tools that investigate vulnerabilities and develop fixes. The two offerings, Red Team and Defense Factory, connect the work of finding security weaknesses with patching and retesting them. Red Team tests applications and verifies fixes Daybreak Red Team, offered through an early-access program, uses coordinated agents to examine application source code and context, investigate potential attack … More → The post OpenAI’s Daybreak brings AI agents to security testing and vulnerability fixes appeared first on Help Net Security .

general.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a high-severity security flaw impacting UnrealIRCd, an open-source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of improper neutralization of delimiters
general.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection

general.summary: A type confusion flaw in PostgreSQL lets a database user who can create objects run code on the server. Updates released yesterday fix it, along with 51 other security flaws. Full protection from this flaw also requires rebuilding any C-language extensions installed on the server. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-6460, has a CVSS score of 8.8.
